caption: The drawing features a single, large, rounded pottery jar centrally placed within a rectangular border. The jar has a slightly flared rim, two small lug handles near the neck, and a broadly cylindrical body tapering slightly toward the base. The surface of the jar is depicted in shades of brown and olive green with irregular, dark wavy and speckled patterns running vertically and horizontally, suggesting a textured or glazed finish. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is an inset box containing a detailed close-up of a section of the jar's rim, showing the inner curvature and surface texture in shades of brown and taupe. The background of the drawing is plain and light-colored, and the artist's name, "Annie B. Johnston," is written in the lower right corner within the bordered area.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
